verdict.rationale: The Washington Secretary of State is a government agency whose core product is the official state registry and filing service (business formation, annual reports, CCFS search, apostilles). Self-hosting that authoritative public-records function is a category error, so the openness/self-host axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable software is distributed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
